::: {#exr-threshold}

#### Where to draw the line

The attacker of @exr-membership knows how the network was trained:
its architecture,
its [width](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/neural-nets.html#def-width),
its number of [training step](pytorch-basics.qmd#def-training-step)s,
and that it saw 100 digits.
The attacker does not know which [loss](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-loss-function) counts as small for this network.
How could the attacker choose a threshold?

:::
